risk_note: Taobao resolveLink second stage (D10-2683 / D10-2893 / D10-2917 / D10-2958; BR-PROD-03, BR-PROD-05, BR-PROD-10; BR-AI-04 detail). Promotion short links (s.click / uland), Taobao tokens and m.tb.cn may go through Dataoke GET /api/tb-service/parse-content only when the brand's parse.third_party.enabled is strictly boolean true; missing, unreadable, non-true values and an adapter without the injected config reader are off and answer adapter_unimplemented without fetching Dataoke credentials or sending any request. When on, the order is official Taobao token parsing first (not implemented, always treated as unavailable) and Dataoke only as fallback; origin 'agent' (both the deterministic runner and the model get_rebate_quote path in assembly.ts) never calls it. Production wiring (registry.ts) does not inject the reader, so production stays off; the key is not in the config registry and must not be enabled by editing the database (enabling needs owner + legal and a separate ticket, FU-PARSE-SWITCH-WIRING). Only data.goodsId is read; goodsId is not used as item_id: item.info.upgrade.get is called and the first item_id string of this response is returned (BR-PROD-05); the item id cache is neither read nor written. pid, commission, conversion url and activityId are never read. Archive: new optional transport field archiveOmitParams is passed only by parse-content and drops content from the stored request summary (not from the wire, not from signing); the response archive keeps only goodsId and classification fields; existing callers are byte-identical (D10-2933); replay ignores omitted parameter names when matching. Success code with missing/null data is a structured link_unrecognized. Product page item.htm path unchanged. No money, order, ledger or db code touched.
